data.name: WtP v2.0
data.body:
## What's Changed




## What the Phage v2.0 — backbone rework

This release is a ground-up rework of the WtP backbone: a modular 7-module pipeline,
a new interactive report, Nextflow 26 support, and an extended tool panel.

### Modular workflow

WtP v2.0 is split into independent Nextflow subworkflows. Run everything with
`--end_to_end`, or pick exactly what you need (flags combine freely):

```
--identify   --annotation   --taxonomy   --prophage   --host   --lifecycle
```

### New interactive report

The R Markdown reports are replaced by a self-contained interactive HTML report
per sample: overview stats, CheckV quality, per-tool identification scores with
heatmap and UpSet plot, annotation coverage, taxonomy comparison, prophage, host
and lifecycle tabs — plus per-sample JSON for downstream use.

### Nextflow 26

Outputs now use the declarative `output {}` block (Nextflow 25.10+; CI-tested
with 26.04.4). Results are written to a restructured, per-sample tree:

```
results/
└── <sample>/{CheckV,identified_contigs_by_tools,annotation,taxonomic-classification,prophage,host_prediction,lifecycle}
    report/          # interactive HTML report + JSON
    literature/      # tool citations
```

### CI & reproducibility

New GitHub Actions workflow ("Syntax check") runs `--help` plus 11 stub-run
combinations on every push; all processes ship stubs (`-profile stub`).
Updated README with badges and a tested-configurations table.

---

**Requirements:** Java, Nextflow ≥ 25.10 (tested 26.04.4), Docker or Singularity.
Databases auto-download (~50 GB end-to-end; optional iPHoP / PhageScope add-ons larger).

**Full documentation:** https://mult1fractal.github.io/WtP_v2_0_webpage/


* Backbone rework  code rework to new  nextflow 26, more tools, nice reporting,  full phage characterization pipeline by @mult1fractal in https://github.com/replikation/What_the_Phage/pull/203


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/replikation/What_the_Phage/compare/v1.2.4...v2.0.0
